theme: Settlement axis bearings, horizons and layout dates; star alignment of Harappan town plans
question: In what directions relative to true north were the Harappan towns laid out, when was each layout built, and does the deviation from the cardinal directions rise with layout date as the setting point of the Pleiades or Aldebaran would require?
outcome: The settlement-axis table holds 29 towns: 21 with coordinates and DEM horizon profiles, 14 with measured lines, 4 with two independent true-north imagery deviations (Mohenjo-daro +0.80 +/- 1.84, Harappa +0.01 +/- 0.51, Lothal -1.88 +/- 0.30, Dholavira -5.50 +/- 1.50), Sutkagen-dor with one (-0.38), 13 with plan measurements and 11 with a layout date of evidence tier 2 or 3. Wanzke 1987 measured in gon: his 8-gon system is Mohenjo-daro's main streets (+6.0 +/- 1.0 on imagery) and his p. 37 '1 to 2 degrees' matches its house blocks. Frozen test: stage 1 chose the equinoctial sunset on Mohenjo-daro and Harappa (chi2 0.38; Alcyone 0.97); P0 undecided with four towns (r = 0.49, p = 0.33, power 0.24); P1 (Pleiades, all clockwise) failed on Dholavira and Lothal; P2 and P3 failed. Amendment 1, declared before any value was read, added plan-based deviations: P0 failed on eleven towns (r = 0.46, one-sided p = 0.082; r = 0.07 without Rangpur). Credence of C-0015 0.04, weakened. With true-north errors of 1 degree at the same eleven towns the frozen P0 would have power 0.97.
challenge: Most Harappan architecture outside Mohenjo-daro, Harappa, Lothal and Dholavira is backfilled, overgrown or not located in the imagery; nearly every published plan has a north arrow of unstated kind, and four plans of the Dholavira castle disagree by up to about 15 degrees; no Bayesian model of a layout boundary exists and five of eleven dates are cross-dated; one plan measurer stalled before declaring main systems; the C: drive filled to zero during the run.
remedy: Four blind measurers with two methods per source class, a dating researcher blind to bearings, a protocol frozen before any value was read or any star position computed, a hashed amendment for the plan-based analysis declared before reading values, plan-north error calibrated against imagery at four towns, synthetic positive and negative controls, a validation gate for the long-term precession, DEM tiles read in memory to spare the disk, and every output written once to a dated directory with input and code hashes.
retry_when: True-north bearings (GNSS, drone or plans registered to ground control) exist for at least eight dated towns, or Bayesian start boundaries replace the cross-dated layout dates. Do not rerun the star test on plans whose north is not stated.
